llm_response.reason: The website impersonates the legitimate LL Bean brand with a lookalike domain (llbeannl.com) and targets Dutch customers. It claims free shipping and returns, pushes urgency through newsletter promotions, and fails to provide authentic company information. Domain ownership is hidden, registered in China, and unrelated to LL Bean. All details fit scam characteristics: mimicking official brands, ambiguous privacy and contact info, and spoofing legitimate e-commerce structure with no evidence of legitimacy.
